meta.title: Rosa & Tom — a wedding on a farm
meta.description: A wedding site as a poster: the names at display size over a golden-hour picture, the date in big numerals, the day as a ruled timetable, the story, a map with places to stay, and an RSVP form. Built from a gogh site definition with Unsplash pictures.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'gogh_booted_as', 'wedding' );
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
try { wp_trash_post( 1 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
$def = json_decode( base64_decode( '' ), true );
if ( is_array( $def ) && function_exists( 'gogh_site_def_boot' ) ) {
	try { gogh_site_def_boot( $def ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
}
